notes:
An overnight fix wave from the editor-parity and usage audits: context menus that behave like native ones, dailies that open like desktop, block identity that survives Duplicate and paste, transclusions that show up in search, and a Sync now that actually syncs now.

**New**

- **Search reaches transcluded text.** A note that embeds a `((block reference))`
  is now found when you search for the referenced text — the projection the PRD
  always intended. Note previews can therefore show transcluded words as part of
  the host note's snippet. (PRD §5.5; ECI-129, #786.)
- **Reorder your pinned notes.** The Pinned view (Home "View all" or the sidebar
  Pinned group header) now mounts the manual-order list with drag-to-reorder;
  the one shared order flows to Home, the sidebar, and All Notes, per the spec.
  (Addendum 22 §6.2; #764.)

**Fixes & polish**

- **Context menus behave like Safari's.** Right-click / long-press menus now
  portal above the page (no more center-screen openings inside collapsed
  content), fit the viewport and the keyboard bar instead of forcing a scroll,
  stop stealing focus (no blue ring, no jump-back), and dismiss when you scroll
  — exactly like the native callout. (Addendum 19 §S4; #775 #776 #777.)
- **A listed daily opens its own page.** Tapping a day note in All Notes,
  Browse, Recents, or a reference card opens that day as a note page — desktop
  behavior — instead of dumping you at the top of the journal stream. Calendar
  picks and journal entries still anchor the stream. (Soham's #774 ruling; #780.)
- **Duplicate no longer re-keys the original block.** Duplicating a block was
  silently changing the *original's* id, breaking every `((ref))`, backlink and
  sync identity pointing at it. (ECI-127; #783.)
- **Paste mints fresh block ids** — pasting a block twice (or into another note)
  no longer creates two blocks with the same identity; a cut→paste still counts
  as a move and keeps its references resolving. (ECI-342; #785.)
- **Typing a closing quote or brace no longer doubles it** — `"` and `{` now
  skip over their auto-inserted closer exactly like `(` always did.
  (ECI-141/147/148; #785.)
- **Heading collapse keeps your caret** — on macOS, `Ctrl+.` was also firing the
  zoom shortcut, folding the section *and* navigating away; `Ctrl+Shift+T`
  likewise no longer opens a tab on top of toggling typewriter mode. (#785.)
- **"Sync now" now really syncs.** A manual sync during a background cycle used
  to silently do nothing; it now queues one follow-up cycle and reports honestly
  ("Already syncing…") when it can't. (#756, #786.)
- **Permanently deleted text leaves search.** Emptying the trash (or the 30-day
  auto-purge) now sheds the deleted note's text from any note that transcluded
  it. (#786.)
- **Accented-title search is fast at scale** — diacritic folding moved to a
  stored column maintained on write instead of being recomputed per keystroke
  across every title. (Addendum 29 §Z5; #771, #786.)
- **A searched daily opens its own page too** — search results now route the
  same way as All Notes rows (the date row "aug 5" still jumps the journal
  stream, deliberately). (Soham's SS-02 ruling; #796.)
- **The updater tells the truth.** A failed update check no longer masquerades
  as "You're up to date" — it retries on a 1–30 minute backoff instead of going
  blind for 6 hours, manual checks report failure honestly, and Connecting /
  Downloading gained a real Cancel. (#797, #798.)
- **The journal keeps every day you visit.** A second calendar pick was reported
  to drop the first day — the windowing was verified correct end-to-end, and the
  test that cried wolf now scrolls back like a person would. (#781, #791.)

**Under the hood**

- iPad hardware-keyboard "silent no-ops" (Shift+Tab with followers, three
  MoveBlock shapes) closed as test-automation delivery artifacts after an
  instrumented re-measure; a physical Magic Keyboard confirmation remains open.
  (C-5/C-6; #789.)
- New storage plumbing for the search projection: `title_folded` and
  `search_text` columns, a pending-refs table for out-of-order sync arrivals,
  and a resumable launch repair (migrations 022–024, #786); manual-sync
  coalescing in the engine with an honest cancelled/busy split.
- Test-suite integrity: the Pro-section test runs from an explicit flag fixture
  (#757); a leaked test decoy no longer cascades one flake into ten (#793);
  perf-quantile and scroll-physics assertions made deterministic.
- Follow-ups filed, not hidden: #784, #787, #788, #790, #792, #793.
